responsibility: Utility script for GCC documentation metadata generation that scans the HTML Concept-and-Symbol index produced by "make html", extracts anchors for documented attributes, groups them by attribute kind (such as function, type, variable, statement, or label), and emits the generated source file gcc/attr-urls.def. The file owns the parsing and normalization logic for attribute index entries, including limited preprocessing of encoded characters and filtering of unsuitable names, and it writes the C tables that later let the compiler map attribute names to manual URL suffixes for diagnostics or help text.
